description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named GroupsController responsible for managing user groups in an admin interface. It provides methods for displaying individual groups, listing all groups, and paginating group data, with role-based access control and integration with service layers for user and country data.

classes.name: GroupsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing user group operations in the admin panel, including viewing and listing groups.

methods.name: displayGroup
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display details of a specific group based on ID.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all groups of type ADMIN.

methods.name: pageGroups
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide a paginated JSON response of all groups.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu-related data for the views.
